name: Audit
about: Scrum Master 3's LIVE Audit, on demand: three questions. Is the agent lock whole (or opened by your own press)? Are The Pin and its reseal in sync? Does every office host answer? Any one failing is red, with your one step.

facts.lock_step: run LOCK yourself, by hand in the terminal (your hand tool): the master lock closed, a fresh seal over your changed files
facts.pin_step: press RUN on The Pin in Scrum Master 3's LIVE group
facts.hosts_step: start the hosts that are down with the auto start: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/ai.positivefeedback.spine.autostart, then press RUN on Audit
facts.empty_step: put the offices back in global_config.json from its last commit: git -C ~/virtual_workspace checkout -- global_config.json, then press RUN on Audit
facts.crash_step: press RUN on Audit again; if it fails the same way, send that line to a builder as a request

card.pitch: The agent lock is whole or opened by your press, The Pin is in sync, every office answers; red if any fails
